origin.procedure: Both production bundles use the same verified in-memory snapshot of every .ts/.tsx in app/src and ui/src. A Bun onLoad hook supplies all matched files. The shared build.ts is copied verbatim and imported from the frozen snapshot. No checkout source mutations.

overrides.operation: Use captured pre-Scrollback app.tsx with only usePrintedLength replaced to return committed.length. The current transcriptRows ignores the old third end argument; all rows are admitted, so it produces the same suffix.

Restore only Line placement destructuring/text computation and the placement/wrappedRows geometry section from HEAD, removing the placement WeakMap optimization. Preserve every other frozen line.tsx change, including header UI edits.

metadata.clock: fresh process; warm filesystem cache; no model/network latency
metadata.memory: main Node process; forced GC at ready and after streaming; RSS includes worker threads
